[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Ake''' was a [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She was present in the [[Strike Base XR-484|Imperial Command Center]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the Empire's [[Invasion of Ossus|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="Eternal Throne" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doctor Ake serves as an Imperial stim vendor on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] in the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''.<ref name="Eternal Throne" />
